beats.text: Deep sleep waves can get **lonely** with age.

beats.label: Young brains
beats.text: In your **20s,** deep-sleep waves travel together across about a **handspan** of scalp.
beats.note: Sharon, Walker et al., Nature Neuroscience 2026

beats.label: Older brains
beats.text: In people **65 to 75,** they travel less and fire **alone.**

beats.label: Next morning
beats.text: More **lonely** waves, fewer word pairs **remembered.** More brain **tau** went with them too.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: None had **Alzheimer's.** It's a link: researchers can't yet say which **comes first.**
Follow for **sleep science** before it hits your **feed.**
